title: Tensor-triangle two-out-of-three for acyclicity
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a site, $\mathcal O$ a sheaf of commutative rings on $\mathcal C$, $\mathcal A^\bullet$ an acyclic complex of $\mathcal O$-modules [def-pc-acyclic-complex-modules], and $K_1^\bullet\to K_2^\bullet$ a morphism of cochain complexes [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules] with mapping cone $K_3^\bullet$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Tensoring the cone sequence with $\mathcal A^\bullet$ identifies the resulting total complex with the mapping cone of the tensor map. If two of the three total tensor complexes $\operatorname{Tot}(\mathcal A^\bullet\otimes_{\mathcal O}K_i^\bullet)$ [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves] are acyclic, then the third is acyclic.

source.place: Lemma 07A3 (sites-cohomology-lemma-K-flat-two-out-of-three), with the cone description from Definition 06YN

proof.text: By the cone comparison for total tensor complexes [lem-pc-tensor-mapping-cone-iso], applied to $\mathcal A^\bullet$ and the morphism $K_1^\bullet\to K_2^\bullet$, the total complex $\operatorname{Tot}(\mathcal A^\bullet\otimes_{\mathcal O}K_3^\bullet)$ [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves] is isomorphic to the mapping cone of the induced map $\operatorname{Tot}(\mathcal A^\bullet\otimes_{\mathcal O}K_1^\bullet)\to\operatorname{Tot}(\mathcal A^\bullet\otimes_{\mathcal O}K_2^\bullet)$. This is the identification of the tensored cone sequence with the cone of the tensor map.

source.place: Lemma 07A3, cone comparison in the proof

proof.text: The cone sequence for $K_1^\bullet\to K_2^\bullet\to K_3^\bullet$ is a distinguished triangle in the homotopy category. After tensoring with the acyclic complex $\mathcal A^\bullet$, Step 1 gives the corresponding triangle of total tensor complexes. The two-out-of-three acyclicity statement [lem-pc-acyclic-triangle-two-out-of-three] therefore implies that if any two of $\operatorname{Tot}(\mathcal A^\bullet\otimes K_i^\bullet)$ are acyclic, then the third is acyclic.
